n3_list.lineage: repackaged from chyyran/jlpt-anki-decks, which the README traces to tanos.co.uk's JLPT lists. Used here only as a WORD-SELECTION seed (which headwords/readings count as N3) — the authoritative reading/sense content in data/lexicon comes from JMdict, not from this file's own meaning column. See docs/CREDITS.md.
n3_list.note: JLPT has published no official vocabulary list since the 2010 test revision, so every N3 list in existence (this one included) is a community reconstruction, not an official standard.
